rationale: Vehicle collision resulting in totaled car and injuries to the policyholder—this is clearly an auto claim under collision coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am; vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat), other driver traveling ~35 mph with no braking. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report obtained with other driver's insurance information.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light, other driver going 35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled, entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: yes, has other driver's insurance info
